commit_message: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B material foundation: Material schema v3 adds generic metallic/roughness and occlusion texture inputs plus normal scale and occlusion strength; glTF maps them through format-neutral IR; runtime binds numeric slots as linear data and consumes them in the shared StandardLit fragment stage. ADR 0120 documents the generic contract. MikkTSpace tangent generation follows in a second commit after this foundation validates.
